_meta.purpose: Instrument specifications used by every calculator in this project.
_meta.why_this_file_exists: Position sizing cannot be done correctly without knowing (a) how many units one lot represents and (b) how big one pip is. Guessing these numbers is one of the most common causes of oversized trades and blown accounts.
_meta.verification_policy: Values marked "verified": true were taken from Exness official documentation on the verification_date shown. Values marked "verified": false are industry-typical conventions that you MUST confirm in MetaTrader 5 > Market Watch > right-click symbol > Specification before risking money.
sources: https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/17854278192284-Forex (forex contract size 100,000, pip size 0.0001-0.01, max leverage 1:2000 / 1:Unlimited, hedged margin 0%, Triple swap Wed / Thu for USDCAD)
https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/17854173039388-Commodities (Gold XAU 100 troy oz, pip 0.01; Silver 5,000 oz; energies 1,000 BBL)
https://www.exness.com/standard-accounts/ (Standard: margin call 60%, stop out 0%, max lot 200 daytime / 60 night, min lot 0.01)
https://get.exness.help/hc/en-us/articles/360014693340-Margin-call-and-stop-out-levels-by-account-type (margin call / stop out by account type)
_meta.important_warning: Specifications change. Spreads, maximum lot sizes, leverage caps and swap rules are broker decisions, not laws of nature. Re-verify before every new phase of trading, and re-run `python main.py doctor` afterwards.
_meta.pip_vs_point_warning: Exness contract-specification tables quote spreads in POINTS (MT4/MT5 'points'), where 1 pip = 10 points for a 5-digit pair. 'Spread from 0.2 pips' on the marketing page still means 0.2 in the platform's point convention for some tables. Always read the live Spread column in Market Watch and convert it yourself with this package before assuming a cost.

XAUUSD.name: Gold vs US Dollar
XAUUSD.note: 1 lot = 100 troy ounces. A 0.01 price move = 1.00 USD per lot. Gold is typically 1.5-3x more volatile in pip terms than EURUSD, so a 'normal looking' gold stop in pips is NOT the same risk as the same number of pips on EURUSD. Size from stop distance, never from habit.

XNGUSD.name: Natural Gas
XNGUSD.note: Exness documentation shows 0.01 in the commodities article and 0.001 in the pip-size table. Verify in MT5 > Specification > Digits/Tick size. This ambiguity is exactly why you never size a trade from memory.

trading_hours_note.forex: Sunday 22:00 UTC (approx.) to Friday 22:00 UTC, continuous. Session logic lives in forex_mastery/core/sessions.py.
trading_hours_note.metals: Similar to forex but with a daily break; confirm current hours with Exness.
trading_hours_note.indices_stocks: Cash-session dependent, with breaks, holidays and different margin requirements. Never trade an instrument whose hours you have not verified.
trading_hours_note.triple_swap: Wednesday is normally triple-swap day for most instruments; Exness documents Thursday as triple-swap day for USDCAD. Holding a position over the rollover can materially change the cost of a trade.
